claim_labels.anisotropic_relation_use: the x venue passes and the exact rotation does not
claim_labels.causal_prefix_sensitivity: the frozen interval for Delta excludes zero
claim_labels.incomplete: a required instrument, venue or freeze is missing
claim_labels.lower_order_context_use: raw D clears SESOI but Delta does not survive Holm
claim_labels.no_controlled_evidence: the controlled interval includes zero or is below SESOI
claim_labels.relational_context_use: causal sensitivity, plus Delta at or above SESOI with the same sign in both model seeds, plus a positive unrelated-block contrast

axis_support.provenance: DECLARED AFTER the v1 exact-rotation venue was scored and BEFORE the y-axis venue was built or scored. The rotation venue's exclusion is therefore reported as a post-hoc diagnostic with its measured ratios, never as a protocol decision; the bounds govern the y venue prospectively.
axis_support.rationale: An axis diagnostic is read against its own primary. The y venue moves only the two copies the relation is about -- about 20% of the prefix's bytes -- so a prefix rate more than half again the primary's means the model has left the regime the primary measured. The matched-target bound of 5x sits at ~1.0-1.2 bits/byte against the corpus's measured generic non-copy rate of 2.7-2.9, so it excludes only a model that has stopped copying at all.

c4.denominator: A program that halts before the target or reaches cap stays in the denominator; target reach is published beside target accuracy.

diagnostic.prompt_boundary: complete byte and instruction boundary before the target

c4.promotion_rule: Expand to 64 draws per world only if the diagnostic's paired preference half-width is at most 0.10 and C3 returned causal_prefix_sensitivity or relational_context_use.
c4.trigger: run the diagnostic for every C3 outcome, positive or not

context_c3.exclusion_rules: Cases are excluded only by the builder, only before weights load, and only for the reasons persisted in census.rejected. No case may be dropped after scoring, and low support is not an exclusion reason.

instrument_notes.source_donor_partition: Evaluated per venue. Venues are scored and resampled separately, so a program that is a primary in one venue and a control donor in another biases neither; the pooled overlap is reported beside it.

context_c3.missingness: A missing control, a missing support column, an unfrozen manifest or a report that is not status=complete yields the label 'incomplete'. Never a negative and never a positive.

multiplicity.seeds: reported separately; never pooled into a population estimate

context_c3.sesoi_rationale: Carried unchanged from the schema-2 driver's frozen threshold, so it predates every schema-3 number. At the step venue's 15-byte target it is 0.30 bits per drawing.

estimand.definition: f(p) = L(y_B|p) - L(y_A|p); D = 0.5*[f(x_A) - f(x_B)]; D_target_control uses unrelated donor targets under the same prefixes; D_block_control uses the same targets under an unrelated prefix block edit; Delta = D - D_target_control; Delta_block = D - D_block_control.
estimand.teacher_forcing: each target is scored under its own prefix history

note: Direction 2's second freeze. v1 authorised the first C3 run and its reports stand exactly as recorded; nothing in them is revised here. v2 adds the in-place y-axis venue and a support precondition on axis diagnostics, because the v1 run showed the exact-rotation venue costs the model 2.3x its own prefix rate and 27x its matched-target rate -- a null there cannot distinguish 'the relation does not transfer' from 'the model has no distribution here'. docs/state-protocol-v2.json remains the Direction 1 record and never authorises a context run.
question: Does changing a relation-bearing fact in a valid prefix move the model's conditional distribution toward the continuation compatible with that change, beyond position, token frequency, perturbation and donor-identity controls?
